workload_suite.prompt_text: Explain the principle of locality in computer memory hierarchies in two concise sentences.
Describe the architectural difference between the prefill and decode phases in autoregressive transformer inference. Discuss operational intensity and memory bandwidth bottlenecks.

Summarize the key engineering trade-offs between dense model inference and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures. Specifically compare total parameter memory storage, active parameter footprint per token, KV-cache memory scaling, and communication overhead under tensor parallelism across multi-accelerator nodes. Highlight why MoE models often achieve lower latency per token while requiring substantially higher aggregate VRAM.
